structured_output.notes: Zero third-party dependencies. Built using vanilla HTML5, modern CSS3 with flexbox and responsive CSS grid, and ES6+ JavaScript. All API interactions use the standard Fetch API communicating directly with /api/bookmarks. Implemented real-time and debounced search filtering, URL normalization, XSS prevention, accessible modal dialogs with keyboard navigation, and responsive card layouts.
structured_output.summary: Implemented the MiniLinks web frontend in examples/minilinks/web/index.html, style.css, and app.js with bookmark creation, debounced search filtering, edit modal, delete confirmation, responsive styling, and notification feedback.
